purpose: machine-facing subdomain knowledge node for planning, evaluating, prioritizing, and validating measurement and validity work units (measurement theory, reliability, validity, operationalization, scaling, invariance/DIF, measurement error, and the psychometric validation workflow) within a knowledge-searcher meta-KB
assumptions: no observed dataset, expert-judgment block, or experimental evidence was supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
subdomain is scoped as concrete, evaluable measurement/validation work units within research methodology and epistemology
modern unified validity view is adopted: content, criterion, and convergent/discriminant evidence are facets of construct validity
interpretation is session-bounded stepwise execution for heavy LLM-assisted measurement-validation work
exclusions: general statistical inference and hypothesis testing beyond psychometric estimation
qualitative-only research design and coding theory except inter-rater agreement
domain-specific item content for any particular field
production software implementation of estimation libraries
